look_here_first: Tall robust ironweed with broader rough leaves and broad terminal arrays of purple discoid heads. Leaves are much broader than in V. lindheimeri.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: tall robust ironweed; broad ovate to lance-ovate rough leaves; hairy/tomentose lower leaf surfaces; broad flattened to irregular terminal arrays; purple discoid heads with no rays

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: V. lindheimeri is much narrower-leaved with strongly revolute margins and densely woolly lower surfaces.

lookalikes.differences: Broad leaves favor V. baldwinii; intermediate plants may be hybrid and should not be forced to a parent.
